description: an old man frost god with a long white beard and white hair, a tall crown of pale blue ice crystals, ornate silver and pale blue armour and long robes with sharp ice crystal shards on the shoulders and at the hem, a dark blue mantle lined with ice hanging behind from the shoulders, silver boots, no staff, no frost orb and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the ice crown to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, headwear, armour, robes, cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the staff and the frost orb
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
